notes: REF-BM-02: no remote metadata fetch; title defaults to URL, no favicon/preview/description collection. REF-BM-03: title/description are manually editable before/after save, but nothing is auto-collected to edit. REF-BM-04: edits url/title/description/tags but there is no note field. REF-BM-06: POST always creates a new record; no duplicate-URL convergence to editing. REF-BM-07: cards show title/description/tags/hostname but no favicon. REF-BM-10: tags entered as free comma-separated text, no autocomplete of existing tags. REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/url but note does not exist. REF-BM-14: tags are matched only as plain substrings; no #tag syntax (no '#' stored in the haystack). REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesis parsing, plain substring only. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag, no unread view, no read/unread toggle. REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-21: no filter-scoped bulk action. REF-BM-22: list is hard-coded to sort by createdAt desc; no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: no markdown note or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML snapshot, PDF handling, or Internet Archive snapshot. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive flag, no archive/delete distinction, no archived view. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no user/display settings.
